001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * History log record Shelf Mode, opCode 53, size 26.
009 *
010 * <br>
011 *
012 * 
013 * <table border='1'>
014 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
015 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>53</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
016 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Shelf Mode"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_SHELF_MODE"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * </table>
019 */
020@HistoryLogProps(
021    opCode = 53,
022    displayName = "Shelf Mode",
023    internalName = "LID_SHELF_MODE"
024)
025public class ShelfModeHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
026
027    private long msecSinceReset;
028    private int lipoIbc;
029    private int lipoAbc;
030    private int lipoCurrent;
031    private long lipoRemCap;
032    private long lipoMv;
033
034    public ShelfModeHistoryLog() {}
035    public ShelfModeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long msecSinceReset, int lipoIbc, int lipoAbc, int lipoCurrent, long lipoRemCap, long lipoMv) {
036        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
037        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, msecSinceReset, lipoIbc, lipoAbc, lipoCurrent, lipoRemCap, lipoMv);
038        this.msecSinceReset = msecSinceReset;
039        this.lipoIbc = lipoIbc;
040        this.lipoAbc = lipoAbc;
041        this.lipoCurrent = lipoCurrent;
042        this.lipoRemCap = lipoRemCap;
043        this.lipoMv = lipoMv;
044
045    }
046
047    public ShelfModeHistoryLog(long msecSinceReset, int lipoIbc, int lipoAbc, int lipoCurrent, long lipoRemCap, long lipoMv) {
048        this(0, 0, msecSinceReset, lipoIbc, lipoAbc, lipoCurrent, lipoRemCap, lipoMv);
049    }
050
051    public int typeId() {
052        return 53;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * <table border="1">
057     * <caption>Parsed fields for ShelfModeHistoryLog:</caption>
058     * <tr><td><code>msecSinceReset</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>lipoCurrent</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>lipoAbc</code></td><td><code>raw[16] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>lipoIbc</code></td><td><code>raw[17] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>lipoRemCap</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>lipoMv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
064     * </table>
065     */
066    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
067        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
068        this.cargo = raw;
069        parseBase(raw);
070        this.msecSinceReset = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
071        // Layout per the Tandem Source event schema: LiPoCurrent int16 @14, LiPo_ABC u8 @16, LiPo_IBC u8 @17.
072        this.lipoCurrent = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
073        this.lipoAbc = raw[16] & 0xFF;
074        this.lipoIbc = raw[17] & 0xFF;
075        this.lipoRemCap = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
076        this.lipoMv = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
077
078    }
079
080    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long msecSinceReset, int lipoIbc, int lipoAbc, int lipoCurrent, long lipoRemCap, long lipoMv) {
081        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
082            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(53, 0),
083            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
084            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
085            Bytes.toUint32(msecSinceReset),
086            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(lipoCurrent & 0xFFFF),
087            new byte[]{(byte) lipoAbc},
088            new byte[]{(byte) lipoIbc},
089            Bytes.toUint32(lipoRemCap),
090            Bytes.toUint32(lipoMv)));
091    }
092
093    public long getMsecSinceReset() {
094        return msecSinceReset;
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * @return battery internal capacity, in percent
099     */
100    public int getLipoIbc() {
101        return lipoIbc;
102    }
103
104    /**
105     * @return battery available capacity, in percent
106     */
107    public int getLipoAbc() {
108        return lipoAbc;
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * @return signed battery current, in mA
113     */
114    public int getLipoCurrent() {
115        return lipoCurrent;
116    }
117
118    public long getLipoRemCap() {
119        return lipoRemCap;
120    }
121
122    public long getLipoMv() {
123        return lipoMv;
124    }
125}
